title: Home - JLINC

principles.title: Transparency and Control in Data Sharing
principles.content: Customers need transparency and control of their data to move beyond the technically and legally opaque models for data sharing most widely in use today.
principles.explanation: This principle emphasizes the importance of transparency and control in the process of data sharing. It suggests that customers should have a clear understanding of how their data is being used and the ability to control its usage.
principles.context: This principle is central to the JLINC protocol, which is designed to provide a platform for trustworthy data exchange.
principles.implementation: JLINC provides transparency and control through its protocol that automates permissioned control of data after it is shared.

policies.title: Data Usage Governance
policies.content: Data usage permissions can be governed by standard framework agreements that no party can unilaterally change.
policies.explanation: This policy suggests that data usage should be governed by agreements that cannot be changed unilaterally, ensuring that all parties involved in data sharing have a say in how the data is used.
policies.context: This policy is part of JLINC's approach to data sharing, which emphasizes transparency, control, and mutual agreement.
policies.implementation: The implementation of this policy is facilitated through JLINC's protocol, which automates the control of data after it is shared.

policies.title: Fiduciary Agents for Data Transactions
policies.content: With JLINC, individuals can have fiduciary agents that work on their behalf under signed contractual agreements.
policies.explanation: This policy proposes the use of fiduciary agents to conduct data transactions on behalf of individuals, ensuring that personal data is used in a transparent way based on agreed-upon terms.
policies.context: This policy is another aspect of JLINC's approach to data sharing, which prioritizes transparency and control for individuals.
policies.implementation: The implementation of this policy is facilitated through JLINC's protocol, which allows for the use of fiduciary agents in data transactions.

values.title: Trustworthy Data Exchange
values.content: JLINC gives all parties both transparency and control before and after they share their data, thus providing a platform for truly trustworthy data exchange.
values.explanation: This value emphasizes the importance of trust in data exchange. It suggests that data exchange should be conducted in a way that is transparent and gives control to all parties involved, thereby fostering trust.
values.context: This value is central to the JLINC protocol, which is designed to provide a platform for trustworthy data exchange.
values.implementation: JLINC implements this value through its protocol that automates permissioned control of data after it is shared.

goals.title: Sustainable Business through Conversions
goals.content: Drives conversions, and delivers measurable results that contribute to sustainable business.
goals.explanation: This goal emphasizes the importance of driving conversions and delivering measurable results to contribute to the sustainability of a business.
goals.context: This goal is part of JLINC's broader mission to provide a platform for trustworthy data exchange that benefits businesses.
goals.implementation: The implementation of this goal is not explicitly mentioned in the content.
